compile_parse_success_rate.note: 12/18 first attempts compiled but table field counts differ from correct_at_1 which also requires zero public failures; compile_parse_success_rate is strictly the build gate = 12/18? recorded conservative 9/18 counting only those with public_repair_gate_passed true on first attempt to align with Correct@1 denominator policy
compile_parse_success_rate.value: 9/18 = 50% (first-attempt public-gate pass, used as compile+public-oracle strict measure)

correct_at_1.method: first completion passes compile/parse and all public oracle cases, no repair

correct_at_n.method: trial eventually passes public gate within max_repair_turns=3

diagnosis_efficiency.formula: among trials needing repair, percent passing on first repair (repair_02)

generated_code_compile_performance.blocker: No dedicated compile-time timing harness (warmups/measured runs) was executed.
generated_code_compile_performance.method: proxy from swiftc -O build wall-time not explicitly measured per Section 6.2 harness

generated_code_memory_efficiency.blocker: No dedicated memory profiling harness was run.
generated_code_memory_efficiency.method: proxy, no dedicated memory profiling performed

generated_code_performance.blocker: No dedicated timing harness run (warmups/measured runs) was executed in this worker for generated binaries; value is a conservative proxy.
generated_code_performance.method: not independently timed under Section 6.2 timing harness in this worker pass; proxy score based on successful compiled/optimized (-O) builds executing without excessive resource use

generation_success_rate.method: all 18 initial completions produced a non-empty candidate source (first attempt)

prompt_robustness.formula: min per-variant first-attempt full-oracle correctness rate across the 3 prompt variants (t1=variant1, t2=variant2, t3=variant3 per cell)

variant_correctness.variant1(t1): svm-spec-t1 fail, svm-port-t1 fail(public), gmm-spec-t1 fail(public), gmm-port-t1 fail(public), lightgrad-spec-t1 pass, lightgrad-port-t1 pass => 2/6=33.33%
variant_correctness.variant2(t2): svm-spec-t2 pass, svm-port-t2 pass, gmm-spec-t2 fail, gmm-port-t2 pass, lightgrad-spec-t2 fail, lightgrad-port-t2 pass => 4/6=66.67%
variant_correctness.variant3(t3): svm-spec-t3 fail, svm-port-t3 pass, gmm-spec-t3 pass, gmm-port-t3 fail(public), lightgrad-spec-t3 fail, lightgrad-port-t3 pass => 3/6=50%

silent_bug_resistance.formula: 100*(eligible-silent_bug)/eligible; eligible = first completions that compile and run oracle

source_token_efficiency.method: proxy from completion_chars across trials (smaller successful sources preferred), normalized

specification_compliance.method: final (post-repair) trials meeting full output-format/protocol spec on the public gate
specification_compliance.value: 12/18 final passes without needing full 3 repairs judged fully compliant; proxy score 66.67

evidence.status: All 18 Primary Swift trials (3 workloads x 2 scenarios x 3 prompt-variant trials) completed with full repair history preserved. All trials reached public-gate pass by repair_03 at latest, within the frozen max_repair_turns=3 budget.

syntax_hallucination_resistance.method: first-attempt compile-clean rate as proxy for absence of hallucinated syntax (markdown fences, invalid API calls) causing parse failure
syntax_hallucination_resistance.observed_failures: 6/18 first attempts failed due to stray markdown code-fence delimiters or invalid API usage (Array.append(contentsOf:) type mismatch)

total_token_efficiency.method: proxy inverse of total repair turns consumed across trial set (9 trials needed extra repair turns out of 18*3 budget)

unseen_case_generalization.blocker: Exact hidden-case pass percentage is runtime/trusted-only and not exposed in worker-visible observations; this is a documented proxy, not the authoritative runner-computed figure.
unseen_case_generalization.method: runner-owned hidden oracle pass percentage on first completion is not separately exposed to this worker; using observed public-case pass rate on first completion as documented proxy since hidden-case identity/output is not visible to this worker
